status: frozen after both v18C source maps were hashed and before loading or scoring either spent replacement-pair target in v18D
purpose: Test whether a target-blind projected member random-stress field supplies transferable apparent-halo amplitude, extent, and one-metric shear structure on the spent MACS J0416 and PLCK G287 pair.

sample.target_interpretation: same-method GLAFIC conventional lens reconstructions used as spent inverse targets, not raw observations or holdouts

map_protocol.coordinate_convention: x positive east and y positive north
map_protocol.target_scaling: multiply the public kappa map normalized at DLS/DS=1 by DLS/DS at source redshift 2
map_protocol.baryon_baseline: baryon-only GR convergence with coefficient fixed to one
map_protocol.member_source: the frozen v18C q_member map at primary neighbor rank 8
map_protocol.one_metric_rule: target, baryon baseline, and member source each generate convergence and both shear components from one E-mode potential

fit.selection: fit the one coefficient on one spent cluster and transfer it unchanged to the other, in both directions

decision_rule: Advance only if every amplitude, full-field, power, shear, extent, coefficient-consistency, and resolution gate passes.
If the member source passes, derive a baryon-forced covariant state equation before opening a holdout; the inverse coefficient cannot be declared fundamental.
If it fails, retire the tested instantaneous projected collisionless-stress source and move to causal history or a materially different mechanism.
Do not tune the neighbor rank, target smoothing, baryon smoothing, aperture, coefficient, or map orientation per cluster.

prior_art.archive_normalization: GLAFIC kappa and shear products are scaled to DLS/DOS=1
prior_art.claim_boundary: This diagnostic use of measured member velocity variance resembles Jeans and stress-energy information; it is not claimed as a new field equation.
